description: Defines the WSC::m2 class for building and parsing WSC M2 attribute lists within IEEE 1905.1 WSC TLVs, including configuration structures, getters, and vendor-specific extensions.

classes.name: WSC::m2
classes.description: Builder/parser for WSC M2 attribute list, handling serialization, validation, and extraction of WSC M2 message fields.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the WSC M2 object with provided configuration and support for BSS index.

methods.name: valid
methods.description: Validates the current WSC M2 object.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a WSC M2 object from a TLV and configuration.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a TLV into a WSC M2 object.

methods.name: manufacturer
methods.description: Returns the manufacturer string from the WSC M2 attributes.

methods.name: encrypted_settings
methods.description: Returns reference to encrypted settings attribute.

methods.name: hidden_ssid
methods.description: Returns hidden SSID status based on vendor extension.

methods.name: vap_type
methods.description: Returns VAP type based on vendor extension.

methods.name: vap_label
methods.description: Returns VAP label string based on vendor extension.
